events.what: Dudko and Lyubich prove MLC at Feigenbaum-type (period-doubling and complex-tripling) parameters; published in Publ. Math. IHÉS vol. 143 (online 2 June 2026)
Kahn, Kapiamba and Lyubich prove a priori bounds and MLC for parabolically bounded primitive renormalization parameters

judgement.doubts: The Dudko–Lyubich result is a pre-snapshot event (first argument Sep 2023); its 2026 journal publication is not a new event (F7), so it cannot set the post-snapshot status. The status rests on the Kahn–Kapiamba–Lyubich preprint alone, a case settlement, unreviewed but by leading experts in the area.

corrections.why: F7/F8: the record dates event to the 2026-06-25 Kahn–Kapiamba–Lyubich preprint; Dudko–Lyubich's result was first posted Sep 2023 (before the snapshot), and its 2026 IHÉS publication is not a new event, so Dudko is not an author of the event the status rests on.
